value.body: Fund accountants keep the books of mutual funds, hedge funds and other investment funds, and calculate their net asset value (NAV). In India much of this work is done at fund administrators, custodian banks and global firms' service centres, often for overseas funds. A typical day involves booking transactions, reconciling positions and checking NAV before a deadline.

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Fund accounting software, Excel, custodian reports

items.label: Common starting titles
items.value: Fund accounting associate, NAV analyst, reconciliation analyst

items.label: Mutual fund industry AUM
items.note: Assets that fund accountants value and reconcile; changes month to month

items.label: SEBI-registered AIFs
items.note: Alternative investment funds, another major employer of fund accountants

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Large service centres hire B.Com graduates through campus drives and walk-ins, with aptitude, accounting and communication tests. Knowledge of accounting basics, financial instruments and Excel helps; some employers train new hires from scratch.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Understanding of equities, bonds and funds

value.title: At a glance
items: Many roles follow US or European hours, so night or late shifts are common.
Common next steps: senior fund accountant, NAV reviewer, or fund operations team lead.
CFA or similar study can help move into investment-side roles later.

competition.note: B.Com graduates in 2023-24 at institutions that reported to AISHE — everyone finishing that degree, not only those entering this role.
